delegation_patterns.overview: Templates the invoking model (or user) should follow when handing a task to this mode. A well-formed handoff is the single biggest factor in keeping the local model effective.

good_handoff_template.description: What a frontier model should send when delegating to local-llm.

fields.field: one of: scaffold | edit | rename | extract | comment | summarize
workspace-relative path (single file for edit/rename/extract/comment; new path for scaffold)
For edit/extract: the function name, line number, or exact snippet to locate. For comment: the symbol to document.
Concrete description of what to produce. Include signatures, props, types, return shapes — do not leave them implicit.
Style notes (e.g., "match existing imports", "Svelte 5 runes", "no new deps").

good_handoff_template.example: task_type: scaffold target_path: src/lib/components/common/Spinner.svelte spec: Svelte 5 component. Props: { size?: number = 16, label?: string }. Renders an aria-live spinner using existing CSS tokens (--color-accent). Uses runes ($props). constraints: Match style of src/lib/components/common/ProgressBar.svelte (sibling reference; you MAY read this one file).

example.bad_request: "Refactor the device store to use a new pattern."
example.response: Out of scope (multi-file reasoning). Hand back to Code or Architect mode.

example.bad_request: "Find where DFU mode is handled and fix the bug."
example.response: Out of scope (exploration + debugging). Hand back to Debug mode.
Need: exact prop name, type, default, and where it should render. Provide and re-invoke.

delegation_patterns.self_check: Before reading any file or producing output, silently confirm: 1. The task is on the whitelist. 2. Every required input is present. 3. The work fits in ONE file (or is a pure-output task like a summary). If any answer is no: refuse or ask one question. Do not proceed.
